Customize and secure your desktop experience with these commands.

### Security & Privacy

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Lock Screen** | `ipc call lockScreen lock` | Lock your screen |
| **Idle Inhibit** | `ipc call idleInhibitor toggle` | Toggle idle inhibitor |
| **Enable Inhibit** | `ipc call idleInhibitor enable` | Enable idle inhibitor |
| **Disable Inhibit** | `ipc call idleInhibitor disable` | Disable idle inhibitor |
| **Airplane Mode** | `ipc call airplaneMode toggle` | Toggle airplane mode |
| **Enable Airplane Mode** | `ipc call airplaneMode enable` | Enable airplane mode (disables Wi-Fi & Bluetooth) |
| **Disable Airplane Mode** | `ipc call airplaneMode disable` | Disable airplane mode |

### Notifications

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **History** | `ipc call notifications toggleHistory` | View past notifications |
| **Get History** | `ipc call notifications getHistory` | Get history as JSON |
| **Do Not Disturb** | `ipc call notifications toggleDND` | Toggle silence mode |
| **Enable DND** | `ipc call notifications enableDND` | Enable silence mode |
| **Disable DND** | `ipc call notifications disableDND` | Disable silence mode |
| **Clear All** | `ipc call notifications clear` | Clear notification history |
| **Remove Oldest** | `ipc call notifications removeOldestHistory` | Remove oldest from history |
| **Remove ID** | `ipc call notifications removeFromHistory $id` | Remove notification by ID |
| **Dismiss Oldest** | `ipc call notifications dismissOldest` | Dismiss oldest active |
| **Dismiss All** | `ipc call notifications dismissAll` | Dismiss active notifications |

### Toast Notifications

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Send** | `ipc call toast send '$json'` | Display a toast notification |
| **Dismiss** | `ipc call toast dismiss` | Dismiss active toast notification |

The toast `send` command accepts a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | string | Yes | Toast title |
| `body` | string | No | Toast body/description |
| `icon` | string | No | Icon name (only for notice type) |
| `type` | string | No | `notice` (default), `warning`, or `error` |
| `duration` | number | No | Duration in ms (defaults: notice=3000, warning=4000, error=6000) |

**Examples:**
```bash
# Simple notice
qs -c noctalia-shell ipc call toast send '{"title": "Recording", "body": "Started (AV1 HDR)", "icon": "media-record"}'

# Warning toast
qs -c noctalia-shell ipc call toast send '{"title": "Low battery", "type": "warning"}'

# Error with custom duration
qs -c noctalia-shell ipc call toast send '{"title": "Connection failed", "body": "Check your network", "type": "error", "duration": 10000}'
```
### Appearance

#### Visibility

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Toggle Bar** | `ipc call bar toggle` | Toggle bar visibility |
| **Show Bar** | `ipc call bar showBar` | Show bar |
| **Hide Bar** | `ipc call bar hideBar` | Hide bar |
| **Peek Bar** | `ipc call bar peek` | Briefly show bar, then auto-hide |
| **Bar DisplayMode** | `ipc call bar setDisplayMode <mode> <screen>` | Set bar display mode |
| **Bar Position** | `ipc call bar setPosition <position> <screen>` | Set bar position |
| **Toggle Dock** | `ipc call dock toggle` | Toggle dock visibility |
| **Show Widgets** | `ipc call desktopWidgets enable` | Enable desktop widgets |
| **Hide Widgets** | `ipc call desktopWidgets disable` | Disable desktop widgets |
| **Toggle Widgets** | `ipc call desktopWidgets toggle` | Toggle desktop widgets |
| **Edit Widgets** | `ipc call desktopWidgets edit` | Toggle widget editing |

> **Available Bar Display Modes**
> - `always_visible`
> - `non_exclusive`
> - `auto_hide`
>
> `<screen>`: Monitor identifier (e.g., `HDMI-A-1`), or use an empty string or `all` to set mode on all monitors.


> **Available Bar Positions**
> - `top`
> - `bottom`
> - `left`
> - `right`
>
> `<screen>`: Monitor identifier (e.g., `HDMI-A-1`). Use an empty string or `all` to set position on all monitors.



#### Theme Controls

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Dark Mode** | `ipc call darkMode toggle` | Toggle system theme |
| **Set Dark** | `ipc call darkMode setDark` | Force dark theme |
| **Set Light** | `ipc call darkMode setLight` | Force light theme |
| **Color Scheme** | `ipc call colorScheme set <theme>` | Set scheme by name |
| **Set Method** | `ipc call colorScheme setGenerationMethod <method>` | Set color generation method |

> **Available Generation Methods**
> - `tonal-spot`
> - `content`
> - `fruit-salad`
> - `rainbow`
> - `monochrome`
> - `vibrant`
> - `faithful`
> - `dysfunctional`
> - `muted`


#### Wallpaper Management

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Selector** | `ipc call wallpaper toggle` | Toggle wallpaper selector |
| **Get Wallpaper** | `ipc call wallpaper get $monitor` | Get path to  wallpaper on monitor |
| **Set Wallpaper** | `ipc call wallpaper set $path $monitor` | Set wallpaper on monitor |
| **Random** | `ipc call wallpaper random $monitor` | Apply random wallpaper (omit monitor for all) |
| **Toggle Auto** | `ipc call wallpaper toggleAutomation` | Toggle automation |
| **Enable Auto** | `ipc call wallpaper enableAutomation` | Enable automation |
| **Disable Auto** | `ipc call wallpaper disableAutomation` | Disable automation |
| **Refresh List** | `ipc call wallpaper refresh` | Refresh wallpapers list |

> **Wallpaper variables**
> - `$path`: Full path to your wallpaper image file
> - `$monitor`: Monitor identifier (e.g., `HDMI-A-1`). Use an empty string or `all` to apply to all monitors.


### Plugin Controls

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Settings** | `ipc call plugin openSettings $pluginId` | Open plugin settings |
| **Open Panel** | `ipc call plugin openPanel $pluginId` | Open plugin panel |
| **Close Panel** | `ipc call plugin closePanel $pluginId` | Close plugin panel |
| **Toggle Panel** | `ipc call plugin togglePanel $pluginId` | Toggle plugin panel |

> **Plugin ID**
> Replace `$pluginId` with the actual plugin identifier (e.g., `todo`, `pomodoro`).


### Misc

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **State** | `ipc call state all` | Output settings state |
| **Set Location** | `ipc call location set $name` | Set geographic location |
| **Get Location** | `ipc call location get` | Get geographic location |
